quotable_insights: Weekend one is about collecting data and offers are a bonus. Data is the requirement.
A listing agent hopes the right buyer shows up, but a listing manager checks the day count, sends the text and blocks Saturday.
episode_summary: This episode introduces a three-week system for real estate listings, emphasizing the importance of a structured launch and data-driven decision-making. By focusing on the first two weeks, agents can avoid price reductions and ensure faster sales, maximizing seller equity and agent commissions.
